description: This file appears to be a shell script that provides utility functions and a sequence of test cases for interacting with Perforce (p4) and Git p4 workflows. It includes functions for managing shelved changelists, initiating server instances, cloning repositories, creating and modifying changelists, and testing the unshelving process in a version control environment.

methods.name: last_shelved_change
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved change number from Perforce.

methods.name: shelve_one_file
methods.description: Creates a new shelved changelist with a specified file, containing a preset description.
